Sejalan dengan dinamika bisnis yang semakin berkembang serta ketatnya persaingan perbankan berbasis digital, Allo Bank terus memperbaiki dan memperkuat struktur organisasinya guna mencapai tujuan yang telah ditetapkan. Struktur organisasi Bank terakhir disahkan melalui Surat Keputusan Direksi No. 082/DIRAB/24 tanggal 18 September 2024 tentang Perubahan Struktur Organisasi. Adapun struktur organisasi Bank di tahun 2024 dapat dilihat sebagai berikut:

In response to the growing dynamics of the business environment and increasing competition in digital banking, Allo Bank continues to enhance and strengthen its organizational structure to achieve its established goals. The Bank's current organizational structure was last ratified through the Decree of the Board of Directors No. 082/DIRAB/24, dated September 18, 2024, concerning changes to the organizational structure. Details of the Bank's organizational structure for 2024 are as follows:

# Penerapan dan Kesesuaian atas Pedoman Tata Kelola Perusahaan Terbuka

Implementation and

Compatibility of Public

Company Governance

Guidelines

Komitmen Allo Bank terhadap Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (Good Corporate Governance) tercermin dalam serangkaian kebijakan dan prosedur operasional yang secara konsisten diterapkan dalam seluruh kegiatan sehari-hari. Bank secara internal juga telah memiliki pedoman pelaksanaan GCG yang mana pedoman tersebut memuat terkait aspek, prinsip, dan rekomendasi Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik. Pedoman ini dirancang untuk memastikan bahwa setiap aspek dari praktik GCG dipenuhi dan berkelanjutan.

Allo Bank selaku perusahaan yang berstatus perusahaan publik senantiasa melaksanakan dan mematuhi seluruh peraturan perundangan- undangan yang berlaku. Bank juga berupaya untuk menciptakan nilai tambah bagi pemegang saham dan para pemangku kepentingan dengan menekankan seluruh kegiatan usahanya pada prinsip-prinsip transparansi, akuntabilitas, dan penyampaian informasi yang wajar sebagai pegangan bagi entitas usaha. Bank juga senantiasa memperhatikan hak pemegang saham tanpa terkecuali, khususnya pemegang saham minoritas yang harus menjadi perhatian dari perusahaan publik terkait.

Allo Bank's commitment to Good Corporate Governance (GCG) is reflected in a series of operational policies and procedures that are consistently applied in daily activities. The Bank also has internal GCG implementation guidelines that outline the key aspects, principles, and recommendations of Good Corporate Governance. These guidelines are designed to ensure that every element of GCG is met and sustained over time.

As a publicly listed company, Allo Bank consistently implements and complies with all applicable laws and regulations. The Bank is also committed to creating added value for shareholders and stakeholders by ensuring that all business activities adhere to the principles of transparency, accountability, and fair information disclosure as a guide for business entities. Additionally, the Bank remains attentive to the rights of all shareholders, particularly minority shareholders, who require special consideration in accordance with public company governance standards.

# Struktur Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

Good Corporate

Governance Structure

Sesuai dengan Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas, Bank memiliki struktur tata kelola perusahaan yang terdiri dari 3 (tiga) organ utama, yaitu Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS), Dewan Komisaris, dan Direksi.

RUPS merupakan forum tertinggi di perusahaan, sedangkan keberadaan Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi merupakan pengejawantahan dari sistem kepengurusan perusahaan dua badan

In accordance with Law No. 40 of 2007 concerning Limited Liability Companies, the Bank's corporate governance structure consists of 3 (three) main organs, namely the General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS), the Board of Commissioners, and the Board of Directors.

The GMS is the highest forum in the company, while the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors represent the embodiment of the two-tier corporate management system.

Company Governance

Bank juga senantiasa memperhatikan hak pemegang saham tanpa terkecuali, khususnya pemegang saham minoritas yang harus menjadi perhatian dari perusahaan publik terkait.

(two-tier system), Dewan Komisaris juga bertindak sebagai pengawas dan pengarah, sementara Direksi bertindak sebagai pengurus perusahaan sehari-hari.

Sementara, dalam melaksanakan tugasnya untuk mengelola dan mengendalikan operasional bisnis serta bertanggung jawab atas implementasi GCG di Bank, Direksi turut dibantu oleh sejumlah Komite di bawah Direksi, yaitu Komite Pengarah Teknologi Informasi, Komite Kebijakan Perkreditan, Komite Produk dan Proses Penerbitan Produk atau Aktivitas Baru, Komite Manajemen Risiko, Komite Kredit, Komite Aset dan Liabilitas (ALCO), dan Komite Sumber Daya Manusia. Selain itu, Direksi juga dibantu oleh organ pendukung lain yang bersifat struktural, yaitu Corporate Secretary & PMO dan Satuan Kerja Audit Internal (SKAI).

The Board of Commissioners also acts as a supervisor and advisor, while the Board of Directors is responsible for the company's daily management.

In carrying out its duties, the Board of Commissioners is assisted by the Board of Commissioners Committees, which are established to support and enhance the supervisory function performed by the Board of Commissioners. These committees include the Audit Committee, Risk Oversight Committee, and Remuneration and Nomination Committee. Meanwhile, in executing its responsibilities to manage and oversee business operations and ensure the implementation of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) within the Bank, the Board of Directors is supported by several committees under its authority. These include the Information Technology Steering Committee, Credit Policy Committee, Product and Process Committee for Issuing New Products or Activities, Risk Management Committee, Credit Committee, Asset and Liability Committee (ALCO), and Human Resources Committee. Additionally, the Board of Directors is supported by other structural units, such as the Corporate Secretary & PMO and the Internal Audit Work Unit (SKAI).
